A '''tool kit''' was a collection of general tools which individuals carried in order to facilitate repairs to equipment. Common tools within the kits included a variety of [[pliers]], [[Hammer (tool)/Legends|hammers]], [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanners]], [[circuit tester]]s, and a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Specific tool kits were available, designed to assist with more specialized repairs or professions. These included [[computer tool kit]]s, [[droid tool kit]]s, [[Security Systems Tool Kit]]s, [[Vehicle Tool Kit]]s,<ref name="SWS" /> and [[agri-kit]]s.<ref name="Iggjel">{{WEGCite|story=Iggjel and the Mother Jungle|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>
